audit.whatIsWrong: The tracked ability is the placeholder 'Ultimate'. The cooldown that actually decides this lane is Aureate Rush (E, 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s), the dash he holds to dodge your engage, and neither his Q auto-reset heal nor his percent-health E is mentioned.
audit.why: The whys already say he holds his dash to dodge Depth Charge, so that is the cooldown to track. The Darkin Glaive (Q, 10/9/8/7/6s) is an auto reset that heals and can be recast for a knock-up; Aureate Rush cuts percent health, so stacking raw HP reads the trade wrong.
audit.corrected: Track Aureate Rush, not 'Ultimate'; add the Q reset-heal tell and the percent-health note.

audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 2 and 3 are credited to Nautilus though both whys call them skill-based coin-flips and the packet chart marks them Skill.
audit.why: Neither side has damage without landed CC at those levels; the lane only tilts once tank stats arrive.
audit.corrected: Levels 2 and 3 Skill; First item and 2+ items stay Nautilus.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[] has only 3 entries; the fourth is absent, and no spike covers his Determination revive.
audit.why: His passive fills with Determination and lets him revive, so a late fight that looks won is not — your ultimate is worth more after the revive than before it.
audit.corrected: Add a fourth spike for the late Determination revive.

edits.after: His passive fills with Determination and lets him revive — hold Depth Charge until after he comes back up, or you spend a 120s ultimate on a body that stands again.
